defs.def: like sb/sth but not exactly the same 相像的；相仿的；类似的

ex.s: Similarly, the corporate world has certainly known its fair share of disruption, yet it is only in the last couple of decades that the “Disruptor” has become a recognisable figure in the way we talk about big business.
ex.t: 在较早的时代，颠覆者会被称作创新者。

ex.s: In a matrix garden, plants with similar cultural needs are grouped so that they will grow together above and below ground, forming a cooperative ecosystem that conserves water and discourages weeds.
ex.t: 我们的大脑利用这个系统来获取有关安全回家路线、高效觅食和规避危险的行为模式。

ex.s: Similarly, anthropomorphized products could be created to take on stereotype-inconsistent roles — a male robot that assists with nursing or a female robot that helps do calculations, for instance.
ex.t: 因此，他们拥有清晰和自信的优势。

ex.s: Comparing yourself with someone who is outperforming you could result in feelings of envy if you focus on the things they have and you don’t, or it can be energizing and inspiring if you use these comparisons as a source of motivation, for example, “If they can achieve that, so can I.” Comparing yourself with someone who is doing worse than you could result in fear and worry if you think about how you could fall into similar circumstances, or it can draw out feelings of gratitude and appreciation if you use that comparison to broaden your views — for example, “Wow, things could be much worse; I’m doing great.”
ex.t: 传粉昆虫：离开还是留下B.

ex.s: A similar process is at work in our response to information.
ex.t: 我们生活在别人的电子游戏中的这个概念对许多人来说有着难以抗拒的吸引力。

ex.s: Good social habits do something similar in a social context.
ex.t: 良好的社会习惯在社会环境中起到类似的作用。

ex.s: If people are similar and tend to make the same errors, then their errors won’t cancel each other out.
ex.t: 如果人们彼此相似并倾向于犯同样的错误，那么他们的错误就不会相互抵消。

ex.s: They are similar in character.
ex.t: 他们性格相似。

ex.s: Although landscapes in the Midwest tend to be quite similar, either farm fields or highways, sometimes I find distinctive character in the hills or lakes.
ex.t: 尽管中西部的风景往往大同小异，不是农田就是公路，但有时我会在丘陵或湖泊中发现独特的韵味。

ex.s: Similar research has been done to understand the “neuronal fireworks” that occur when we look at inspiring sculptures, attractive faces, impressive dance, etc
ex.t: 类似的研究已被用来理解当我们观看鼓舞人心的雕塑、迷人的面孔、令人印象深刻的舞蹈等时发生的"神经元烟花"。

ex.s: If you see a painting of a movement, like of a man pulling his arm away after being bitten by a dog, you feel like going through a similar experience.
ex.t: 如果你看到一幅描绘运动的画作，比如一个人被狗咬后缩回手臂的画面，你会感觉自己经历了类似的体验。

ex.s: Another study from 2021 tested for “theory of mind” in dogs in a similar way, but the dogs were able to walk round the screen to obtain the treat after witnessing the experimenter’s “unwilling” or “unable” behaviour.
ex.t: 尽管如此，随着发令枪的一声巨响，我会用尽全力跳进冰冷的水中，以最快的速度游到泳池另一边，结果却发现其他选手都从我身边滑过。

ex.s: Now, more evidence has been provided that dogs distinguish between similar actions associated with different intentions.
ex.t: 当我终于抓住泳池边缘时，他总是在那里拿着一条温暖干爽的毛巾，告诉我他为我不懈的努力感到多么骄傲。

ex.s: Goffin’s cockatoos, a kind of small parrot native to Australasia, have been shown to have similar shape-recognition abilities to a human two-year-old.
ex.t: 戈芬氏凤头鹦鹉，一种原产于澳大拉西亚的小型鹦鹉，被证明具有与人类两岁幼儿相似的形状识别能力。

ex.s: Where trial-and-error was used, the cockatoos did better than monkeys in similar tests.
ex.t: 在使用试错法的情况下，凤头鹦鹉的表现优于类似测试中的猴子。

ex.s: This indicates that Goffin’s cockatoos do indeed possess an allocentric frame of reference when moving objects in space, similar to two-year-old babies.
ex.t: 这表明戈芬氏凤头鹦鹉在移动物体时确实拥有异中心参照系，类似于两岁的婴儿。

ex.s: Blind people recognize shapes with their ____40____ (exist) senses, in a way similar to that of ____41____ (sight )people, says Ella Striem-Amit, a Harvard scientist.
ex.t: 盲人用他们的____40____ (exist)现有感官识别形状，方式与____41____ (sight )视力正常的人相似，哈佛科学家Ella Striem-Amit说。

ex.s: The differences between most of the groups were statistically insignificant; however,the participants in the 70 decibels group—those exposed to a level of noise similar to background chatter in a coffee shop-significantly outperformed the other groups.
ex.t: 但由于70分贝的结果显著，这项研究也表明适当水平的背景噪音——不太响也不完全安静——实际上可能提高一个人的创造性思维能力。

ex.s: Similarly, if you speak only Chinese, receiving a card in Swedish takes part of the fun away.
ex.t: 同样如果你只会中文收到一张瑞典语的明信片就会失去部分乐趣。

ex.s: Many people enjoy relaxing music in the evening prior to going to bed．____37____While the validity of the idea is still being assessed，the lowered stress can even be tied back to blood pressure．Similarly, according to researchers，listening to just 30 minutes of soft music every day may help with healthy blood sugar levels， through the lowering of stress and anxiety．
ex.t: 许多人喜欢在晚上睡前听放松的音乐。____37____虽然这种观点的有效性仍在评估中但压力的降低甚至可能与血压有关。同样根据研究人员每天只需听30分钟轻音乐就可能通过减轻压力和焦虑有助于健康的血糖水平，

ex.s: The results were similar to the first test: the participants followed suit but took significantly more candy when the thin actor took 30 pieces.
ex.t: 结果与第一次测试相似：参与者们纷纷效仿，但当瘦演员拿30块糖果时，他们拿的糖果明显更多。

ex.s: Cheese brine has a downside too a smell similar to that of bad milk.
ex.t: "我真的不介意，"Emil Norby告诉《现代农民》杂志说。

ex.t: 现在的问题与过去的问题相似。

ex.s: A spotlight lights up only one section of a stage; similarly,"spotsound" creates a circle of sound in on targeted area.
ex.t: 只需转动机器或将它对准目标，你的安宁和宁静就回来了。

ex.s: He added that he hopes people in other cities might try similar projects and post their own videos on the Internet.
ex.t: 他补充说，他希望其他城市的人可以尝试类似的项目并在互联网上发布自己的视频。

ex.t: 它们有相似的模式。

ex.t: 他们有相似的特征。

ex.t: 有人说新来者学习东道国语言是很自然的，将其视为确保他们能为社会做出贡献的条件。

ex.t: 同样，当人们几天不睡觉时，他们会生病。
